verdict.rationale: The evidence shows virtual cards (VCN) issued for hotel and air bookings, travel-specific cards with set limits, and a credit line for the tourism sector. These are payment instruments used for bookings made elsewhere. Nothing shows an in-platform flight or hotel booking flow, or a travel policy enforced at booking time. Card limits are an adjacent spend control, not booking-time travel policy.

support.subject: As an employee, I can book flights and hotels in-platform with travel policy applied at booking time, not expensed and argued about later
